title: Certified spectral approximation of transfer operators and the Gauss map
summary: We prove that the full spectral picture of a transfer operator (every isolated eigenvalue, eigenvector, and Riesz projector outside the essential spectral radius) can be approximated to arbitrary precision by finite-rank discretizations, with no spectral pollution.
